name: ResumeForge-AI
description: AI-powered resume builder with professional templates, smart suggestions, live preview, and one-click PDF export using Vite and JavaScript.

paragraphs: ResumeForge AI is a responsive, browser-based resume builder created with Vanilla JavaScript and Vite. It provides a structured multi-step workflow for entering professional information, selecting a resume design, reviewing the generated document, receiving smart content suggestions, and downloading the final resume as a PDF.
The application currently runs entirely on the client side and does not require a backend, database, account, or external AI API.
Implementation note: The current AI Suggestions feature uses rule-based resume checks to identify missing or weak sections. A generative AI or LLM integration can be added in a future release.
features: Guided seven-step builder for personal details, education, experience, skills, projects, certifications, achievements, and template selection.
Dynamic entries for adding or removing multiple education, experience, project, and certification records.
Instant resume preview with template switching.
Smart resume suggestions for summaries, skills, experience descriptions, projects, professional links, and certifications.
